verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Taa-seen tilka aayaatul-qur'aani wa kitaabin mubeen
Hudan wa bushraa lilmu'mineen
Al-ladheena yuqeemoonas-salaata wa yu'toonaz-zakaata wa hum bil-aakhirati hum yooqinoon
Innal-ladheena laa yu'minoona bil-aakhirati zayyannaa lahum a'maalahum fahum ya'mahoon
Ulaa'ikal-ladheena lahum soo'ul-adhaabi wa hum fil-aakhirati humul-akhsaroon
Wa innaka latulaqqal-qur'aana min ladun hakeemin aleem
Idh qaala moosaa li'hlihi innee aanastu naaran sa'aateekum minhaa bikhabarin aw aateekum bishihaabin qabasin la-allakum tastaloon
Falammaa jaa'ahaa noodiya an boorika man fin-naari wa man hawlahaa wa subhaanallaahi rabbil-aalameen
Yaa moosaa innahu anaa Allaahul-azeezul-hakeem
Wa alqi asaaka falammaa ra'aahaa tahtazzu ka'annahaa jaannun wallaa mudbiran wa lam yu'aqqib yaa moosaa laa takhaf innee laa yakhaafu ladayyal-mursaloon
Illaa man zalama thumma baddala husnan ba'da soo'in fa-innee ghafoorun Raheem
Wa adkhil yadaka fee jaybika takhruj baydaa'a min ghayri soo'in fee tis'i aayaatin ilaa fir'awna wa qawmihi innahum kaanoo qawman faasiqeen
Falammaa jaa'athum aayaatunaa mubsiratan qaaloo haadhaa sihrun mubeen
Wa jahadoo bihaa wastayqanathaa anfusuhum zulman wa uluwwan fanzur kayfa kaana aaqibatul-mufsideen
Wa laqad aataynaa daawooda wa sulaymaana ilman wa qaalal-hamdu Lillaahil-ladhee faddalanaa alaa katheerin min ibaadihil-mu'mineen
Wa waritha sulaymaanu daawooda wa qaala yaa ayyuhan-naasu ullimnaa mantiqat-tayri wa ooteenaa min kulli shay'in inna haadhaa lahuwal-fadlul-mubeen
Wa hushira lisulaymaana junooduhu minal-jinni wal-insi wat-tayri fahum yooza'oon
Hattaa idhaa ataw alaa waadin-namli qaalat namlatun yaa ayyuhan-namlu udkhuloo masaakinakum laa yahtimannakum sulaymaanu wa junooduhu wa hum laa yash'uroon
Fatabassama daahikan min qawlihaa wa qaala rabbi awzi'nee an ashkura ni'matakal-latee an'amta alayya wa alaa wa-dayya wa an a'mala saalihan tardaahu wa adkhilnee birahmatika fee ibaadikas-saaliheen
Wa tafaqqadat-tayra faqaala maa lee laa aral-hudhuda am kaana minal-ghaa'ibeen
La-u'adhdhibannahu adhaaban shadeedan aw la-adhbahannahu aw laya'tiyanee bisultaanin mubeen
Famakatha ghayra ba'eedin faqaala ahattu bimaa lam tuhit bihi wa ji'tuka min saba'iin binaba'iin yaqeen
Innee wa jadttu imra'atan tamlikuhum wa ootiyat min kulli shay'in wa lahaa arshun azeem
Wa jadtuhaa wa qawmahaa yasjudoona lish-shamsi min doonillaahi wa zayyana lahumush-shaytaanu a'maalahum fasaddahum anis-sabeeli fahum laa yahtadoon
Allaa yasjudoo Lillaahil-ladhee yukhrijul-khab'a fis-samaawaati wal-ardi wa ya'lamu maa tukhfoona wa maa tu'linoon
Allaahu laa ilaaha illaa huwa rabbul-arshil-azeem
Qaala sananzuru asadaqta am kunta minal-kaadhibeen
Idhhab bikitaabee haadhaa fa-alqih ilayhim thumma tawalla anhum fanzur maadhaa yarji'oon
Qaalat yaa ayyuhal-mala'u innee ulqiya ilayya kitaabun kareem
Innahu min sulaymaana wa innahu bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Allaa ta'loo alayya wa toonee muslimeen
Qaalat yaa ayyuhal-mala'u aftoonee fee amree maa kuntu qaati'atan amran hattaa tashhadoon
Qaaloo nahnu uloo quwwatin wa uloo ba'sin shadeedin wal-amru ilayki fanzuree maadhaa ta'mureen
Qaalat innal-mulooka idhaa dakhaloo qaryatan afsadoohaa wa ja'aloo a'izzata ahlihaa adhillatan wa kadhalika yaf'aloon
Wa innee mursilatun ilayhim bihadiyyatin fanaaziratun bima yarji'ul-mursaloon
Falammaa jaa'a sulaymaana qaala atumiddoonani bimaalin famaa aataaniya Allaahu khayrun mimmaa aataakum bal antum bihadiyyatikum tafrahoon
Irji ilayhim falana'tiyannahum bijunoodin laa qibala lahum bihaa wa lanukhrijannahum minhaa adhillatan wa hum saaghiroon
Qaala yaa ayyuhal-mala'u ayyukum ya'teenee bi-arshihaa qabla an ya'toonee muslimeen
Qaala ifrytun minal-jinni anaa aateeka bihi qabla an taqooma min maqaamika wa innee alayhi laqawiyyun ameen

Qaalal-ladhee indahu ilmun minal-kitaabi anaa aateeka bihi qabla an yartadda ilayka tarfuka falammaa ra'aahu mustaqirran indahu qaala haadhaa min fadli rabbee liyabluwanee a'ashkuru am akfuru wa man shakara fa-innamaa yashkuru linafsihi wa man kafara fa-inna rabbee ghaniyyun kareem
Qaala nakkiroo lahaa arshahaa nanzur atahtadee am takoonu minal-ladheena laa yahtadoon
Falammaa jaa'at qeela ahakadhaa arshuki qaalat ka'annahu huwa wa ooteenal-ilma min qablihaa wa kunnaa muslimeen
Wa saddahaa maa kaanat ta'budu min doonillaahi innahaa kaanat min qawmin kaafireen

Qeela lahad-khulis-sarha falammaa ra'athu hasibathu lujjatan wa kashafat an saaqayhaa qaala innahu sarhun mumarradun min qawaareera qaalat rabbi innee zalamtu nafsee wa aslamtu ma'a sulaymaana Lillaahi rabbil-aalameen
Wa laqad arsalnaa ilaa thamooda akhaahum saalihan ani-budoo Allaaha fa-idhaa hum fareeqaani yakhtasimoon
Qaala yaa qawmi lima tasta'jiloona bis-sayyi'ati qablal-hasanati lawlaa tastaghfiroona Allaaha la-allakum turhamoon
Qaalut-tayyarnaa bika wa biman ma'aka qaala taa'irukum indallaahi bal antum qawmun tuftanoon
Wa kaana fil-madeenati tis'atu rahtin yufsidoona fil-ardi wa laa yuslihoon
Qaaloo taqaasamoo Billaahi lanubayyitannahu wa ahlahu thumma lanaqoolanna liwaliyyihi maa shahidnaa mahlika ahlihi wa innaa lasaadiqoon
Wa makaroo makran wa makarnaa makran wa hum laa yash'uroon
Fanzur kayfa kaana aaqibatu makrihim annaa dammarnaahum wa qawmahum ajma'een
Fatilka buyootuhum khaawiyatan bimaa zalamoo inna fee dhaalika la-aayatan liqawmin ya'lamoon
Wa anjaynal-ladheena aamanoo wa kaanoo yattaqoon
Wa lootan idh qaala liqawmihi ata'toonal-faahishata wa antum tubsiroon
A'innakum lata'toonar-rijaala shahwatan min doonin-nisaa bal antum qawmun tajhaloon
Famaa kaana jawaaba qawmihi illaa an qaaloo akhrijoo aala lootin min qaryatikum innahum unaasun yatatahharoon
Fa-anjaynaahu wa ahlahu illam-ra'atahu qaddarnaahaa minal-ghaabireen
Wa amtarnaa alayhim mataran fasaa'a matarul-mundhareen
Qulil-hamdu Lillaahi wa salaamun alaa ibaadihil-ladheena istafaa aalllahu khayrun ammaa yushrikoon

Amman khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda wa anzala lakum minas-samaa'i maa'an fa-anbatnaa bihi hadaa'iqa dhaata bahjatin maa kaana lakum an tunbitoo shajarahaa a'ilahun ma'a Allaahi bal hum qawmun ya'diloon
Amman ja'alal-arda qaraaran wa ja'ala khilaalahaa anhaaran wa ja'ala lahaa rawaasiya wa ja'ala baynal-bahrayni haajizan a'ilahun ma'a Allaahi bal aktharuhum laa ya'lamoon
Amman yujeebul-mudtarra idhaa da'aahu wa yakshifus-soo'a wa yaj'alukum khulafaa'al-ardi a'ilahun ma'a Allaahi qaleelan maa tadhakkaroon
Amman yahdeekum fee zulumaatil-barri wal-bahri wa man yursilur-riyaaha bushran bayna yaday rahmatihi a'ilahun ma'a Allaahi ta'aalaa Allaahu ammaa yushrikoon
Amman yabda'ul-khalqa thumma yu'eeduhu wa man yarzuqukum minas-samaa'i wal-ardi a'ilahun ma'a Allaahi qul haatoo burhaanakum in kuntum saadiqeen
Qul laa ya'lamu man fis-samaawaati wal-ardil-ghayba illaa Allaahu wa maa yash'uroona ayyaana yub'athoon
Bal iddaaraka ilmuhum fil-aakhirati bal hum fee shakkin minhaa bal hum minhaa amoon
Wa qaalal-ladheena kafaroo a'idhaa kunnaa turaaban wa aabaa'uunaa a'innaa lamukhrajoon
Laqad wu'idnaa haadhaa nahnu wa aabaa'uunaa min qablu in haadhaa illaa asaateerul-awwaleen
Qul seeroo fil-ardi fanzuroo kayfa kaana aaqibatul-mujrimeen
Wa laa tahzan alayhim wa laa takun fee dayqin mimmaa yamkuroon
Wa yaqooloona mataa haadhal-wa'du in kuntum saadiqeen
Qul asaa an yakoona radifa lakum ba'dul-ladhee tasta'jiloon
Wa inna rabbaka ladhoo fadlin alan-naasi wa laakinna aktharahum laa yashkuroon
Wa inna rabbaka laya'lamu maa tukinnu sudooruhum wa maa yu'linoon
Wa maa min ghaa'ibatin fis-samaa'i wal-ardi illaa fee kitaabin mubeen
Inna haadhal-qur'aana yaqussu alaa banee israa'eela aktharal-ladhee hum feehi yakhtalifoon
Wa innahu lahudan wa rahmatun lilmu'mineen
Inna rabbaka yaqdee baynahum bihukmihi wa huwal-azeezul-aleem
Fatawakkal alaa Allaahi innaka alal-haqqil-mubeen
Innaka laa tusmi'ul-mawtaa wa laa tusmi'us-summad-du'aa'a idhaa wallaw mudbireen
Wa maa anta bihaadil-umyi an dalaalatihim in tusmi'u illaa man yu'minu bi-aayaatinaa fahum muslimoon
Wa idhaa waqa'al-qawlu alayhim akhrajnaa lahum daabbatan minal-ardi tukallimuhum annan-naasa kaanoo bi-aayaatinaa laa yooqinoon
Wa yawma nahshuru min kulli ummatin fawjan mimman yukadhdhibu bi-aayaatinaa fahum yooza'oon
Hattaa idhaa jaa'oo qaala akadhdhabtum bi-aayaatee wa lam tuheetoo bihaa ilman ammaadhaa kuntum ta'maloon
Wa waqa'al-qawlu alayhim bimaa zalamoo fahum laa yantiqoon
Alam yaraw annaa ja'alnal-layla liyaskunoo feehi wan-nahaara mubsiran inna fee dhaalika la-aayaatin liqawmin yu'minoon
Wa yawma yunfakhu fis-soori fafazi'a man fis-samaawaati wa man fil-ardi illaa man shaa'a Allaahu wa kullun atawhu daakhireen
Wa taral-jibaala tahsabuhaa jaamidatan wa hiya tamurru marras-sahaabi sun'a Allaahil-ladhee atqana kulla shay'in innahu khabeerun bimaa taf'aloon
Man jaa'a bil-hasanati falahu khayrun minhaa wa hum min faza'in yawma'idhin aaminoon
Wa man jaa'a bis-sayyi'ati fakubbat wujoohuhum fin-naari hal tujzawna illaa maa kuntum ta'maloon
Innamaa umirtu an a'buda rabba haadhihil-baldatil-ladhee harramahaa wa lahu kullu shay'in wa umirtu an akoona minal-muslimeen
Wa an atluwal-qur'aana famani ihtadaa fa-innamaa yahtadee linafsihi wa man dalla faqul innamaa anaa minal-mundhireen
Wa qulil-hamdu Lillaahi sayureekum aayaatihi fata'rifoonahaa wa maa rabbuka bighaafilin ammaa ta'maloon
